fields.description:
**DRAFT — for Kobi/Taryn review before grooming**

**Context**
Emily asked for a quick-action button on each Sign-Up table row to log a sign-up in a pop-up (WAGR-436). The standard list view cannot do this. Row dropdown actions are limited, and bulk actions cannot be used for Log Sign Up or Complete Sign Up because each record needs its own input.

Kobi (Slack, 2026-10-02): a custom LWC-based list view with row-level action buttons may be possible, but not for V1. V1 UX is built around the Split view. This is a post-go-live enhancement to scope and prioritize against the other post-go-live work the client wants.

**Requirements (proposed, to confirm)**

* Custom LWC list view for Sign-Ups with an **Action** column on each row.
* One primary action button per row (for example, Log Sign Up / Complete Sign Up, based on row status).
* A caret menu for secondary actions (for example, Open details).
* Row actions are defined by Jumpr. Edit, Delete, Change Owner and Edit Labels do not show to non-admin users.
* Reference pattern: the Redeposits prototype "My Redeposits" list view (primary button per row plus caret menu). Attach Kobi's screenshot of it.

**Open questions**

* Which actions and statuses need row-level buttons, and which fields appear in the pop-up vs. the full record? (Not specified by Emily.)
* Does the custom list view replace the standard list view or sit next to it?
* Size and priority vs. other post-go-live work. Do not estimate until scoped.
* Do the Split view and this list view need to work together?

**Constraints / Dependencies**

* Out of V1 scope. Depends on go-live.
* Related: WAGR-436 (V1 work: remove row dropdown actions for non-admins, confirm Log Sign Up / Complete Sign Up flows still work for non-admin users).
* Bulk actions (bulk archive, fraud flagging) are separate V2 stories, only if the client asks.

**Source**

* WAGR-436, Sep 29 update (per Kobi).
* Kobi Slack message, 2026-10-02, 10:46 AM ET: https://jumpr-solutions.slack.com/archives/C0BRW5L8SUA/p1790952381598149
* Wagertech Internal Sync, 2026-10-02 (ticket 436 discussion).
fields.summary: Phase 2: Custom list view with row-level action buttons for Sign-Ups (scope and prioritize)
